name: CreditAssessment
description: The credit risk assessment record owned by SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004). Created in PH-018 (JRN-007) in response to EVT-032 (CreditAssessmentRequested). Contains automated IRB model outputs (PD, LGD, EAD, ECL) and the credit committee decision. IMPORTANT: This entity is owned by CAP-004/SVC-012, NOT by SVC-005. Cross-capability boundary — SVC-005 holds only the assessment_id reference received via EVT-033.

fields.name: assessment_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-012. Immutable.

fields.name: risk_rating
fields.validation_rule: Required. Integer 1–10. Internal risk grade. Ratings 8–10 trigger mandatory credit committee referral.

fields.name: pd_score
fields.validation_rule: Required. Decimal 0.0001–1.0000 (4 dp). 1-year through-the-cycle Probability of Default per PRA PS17/23 IRB standard.

fields.name: lgd_estimate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Decimal 0.0000–1.0000 (4 dp). Downturn Loss Given Default. Unsecured floor = 0.45 (Basel 3.1).

fields.name: ead
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 2 dp (GBP). Exposure at Default.

fields.name: ecl_provision
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 2 dp (GBP). IFRS 9 ECL = PD × LGD × EAD.

fields.name: analyst_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Staff.staff_id for Credit Analyst (PER-056). SMCR accountability.

fields.name: committee_decision
fields.validation_rule: Required after PH-019. Enum: pending_committee | approved | approved_with_conditions | declined. Immutable once terminal.

fields.name: committee_decided_at
fields.validation_rule: Set when committee_decision reaches terminal value. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

relationships.description: CreditAssessment belongs to one LoanApplication via application_id FK. Multiple assessments may exist for the same application across annual reviews in PH-022.

design_decisions.decision: CreditAssessment owned by SVC-012 (CAP-004). SVC-005 holds only the assessment_id reference.
design_decisions.rationale: IRB model outputs are CRO accountability domain under SMCR. Independent lifecycle required for PRA IRB model validation audits.

design_decisions.decision: analyst_id on CreditAssessment is the SMCR accountability trail for the credit paper.
design_decisions.rationale: SMCR requires every material credit decision to be attributable to a named Certified Function holder.
